title: C TDMA: wire SFN-wrap + epoch-floor validation into DesyncFSM inputs + desync vectors
description: Child of b7z9.12, lands after the FSM-core child. Review 3x kimi-k3: pass 2 confirmed the vector cases fully cover all JSON-encoded fields and uint8 promotion cleanliness; passes 1/3 explored CI coverage (tdma_guard_budget runs via ctest host harness; not a named CI target — the lichen/tests twister sweep in ec2-arm64 covers Zephyr-side, host ctest runs locally/pre-merge) and NDEBUG (absent).
